event_chain.summary: Misdelivery: mass email with recipients visible

summary: On 29 July 2026 the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) emailed 136 health practitioners an invitation to a webinar on substance-misuse notifications without hiding the recipients' addresses. This exposed the identities of doctors, nurses and other practitioners, many with health-related notifications or restrictions, to each other, even though the invitation promised anonymity. AHPRA found the error the same day, asked recipients to delete the email, apologised, and notified the National Health Practitioner Ombudsman.
